Interface GameObject

All Known Implementing Classes:
Accessory, AcolyteHat, Bible, Blindfold, Blue, Character, Chest, Cleave, Dismantle, Enemy, Entity, ExpOrb, GojoGlasses, Harvest, Infinity, Item, KeyPad, Lazer, MalevolentKitchen, MaximumBlue, MaximumCleave, MaximumDismantle, MaximumOutputInfinity, MaximumRed, Red, SixEye, Soda, Standard, SubaruShirt, SukunaArm, SukunaCloak, SukunaFinger, UnlimitedHollowPurple, Weapon
public interface GameObject
Prototype interface implemented by every game object that can be duplicated.

The game maintains "master lists" of weapons, accessories, and items that act as templates. When a copy is needed (e.g. handing a weapon to the player or dropping an item on the map), copy() produces a fresh, independent instance from the template without needing to know the concrete type.

Every class that extends Entity must implement this interface, providing a deep-enough copy that the clone can be used independently of the original.

    • copy

      GameObject copy()
      Creates and returns a copy of this game object.

      The returned object must be independent of the original — modifying it must not affect the template stored in the master list.

      Returns:
      a new instance with the same initial state as this object
